children: Fox announced a two-step merger agreement to acquire Roku, with DOJ issuing an HSR second request that extends regulatory review.
Fox agreed to a two-step merger: Merger Sub 1 merges into Roku, then Roku merges into Merger Sub 2, making Roku a Fox subsidiary.
DOJ issued a Second Request on Sept 8, 2026, extending the HSR waiting period until compliance or earlier termination.
Fox expects the Mergers to close in H1 2027, subject to HSR clearance and other customary closing conditions and stockholder approvals.
Fox filed an S-4 and definitive joint proxy/prospectus; investors urged to read SEC filings for full transaction details.
